### Steps to Review
1. From a terminal in the project root run `git checkout develop`
2. Run `git fetch`
3. Run `git pull`
4. Check out the branch under test via `git checkout <branch name here>`
5. Set up the environment and run the app per the [README](https://github.com/daniel-pittman/rubiks-cube-solver#installation--running): create a venv, then `pip install -e ".[all,dev]"` (or run `./run_app.sh`, which provisions the venv and shows a menu for the CLI, web, and desktop interfaces)
6. Run the test suite with `pytest`
7. Add more steps as needed
